<insights>
- The text mentions "All I Do Is Think of You" as a ballad single released by The Jackson 5 as the B-side to the group's single, "Forever Came Today" on the Motown label in 1975.
- The Jackson 5 left Motown for CBS the following year, so this album would have been their last release under Motown.
- The Jackson 5's last Motown album was "Moving Violation," which was released in 1975.
</insights>

<answer>
The December 1969 music album by the artist who made "All I Do Is Think of You" was "Moving Violation" by The Jackson 5.
</answer>

<subanswer>
- The Jackson 5's last Motown album was "Moving Violation," which was released in 1975.
</subanswer>
